statements.t: The Company plans to use the proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes.
The Company does not expect to write any commercial lines business in the near term.
We do not anticipate any dividends being paid to the Parent Company from our insurance subsidiaries in the near term.

With the receipt of this payment along with future anticipated revenue from TIC, management believes the Company has the ability to meet its obligations as they become due over the next twelve months.

estimates.t: In certain circumstances, we are required to make estimates and assumptions that affect amounts reported in our condensed consolidated financial statements and related footnotes.

estimates.name: Executive Overview
estimates.t: The Company's gross written premiums decreased $8.5 million, or 57.8%, to $6.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $14.6 million for the same period in 2025.

statements.t: Following the decision to non-renew its Midwest homeowners business, the Company's Personal Lines portfolio now consists exclusively of Texas homeowners policies going forward.
